stories.summary: The revised pay scale for garment workers will take effect in December, the minimum wage board's chairman said after its first meeting on 4 November, with workers receiving their first salary under the new scale in January. The six-member board was formed on 1 November amid protests demanding a Tk 30,000 minimum wage, against the current Tk 12,500. stories.summary: US Vice President JD Vance said on 4 November that the Iran war was the reason Republicans lost the midterms, adding that President Trump had said so himself, and warned that losing the Senate for six years was the price of the war. A Dhaka South City Corporation survey found 29 of its 75 wards at high risk of dengue transmission, 28 at moderate risk and 18 at low risk, with Aedes larvae found in 403 of 2,250 surveyed households.

stories.summary: Bangladesh is considering creating a sovereign fund of up to $2 billion to mobilise international capital for infrastructure, renewable energy and digital projects, Finance Minister Amir Khosru Mahmud Chowdhury said during a visit to Seoul. stories.summary: Bangladesh Bank disconnected online payment gateway DGePay from the National Payment Switch Bangladesh on 29 October over security concerns, including alleged server access from India, central bank spokesperson Arief Hossain Khan said. stories.summary: At least 1,173 police constables, mostly recruited in Dhaka during the Awami League government's tenure, used fake permanent addresses to secure jobs under district-based recruitment quotas, a police investigation found.
